lines: - "Ah, please, please, with me. The place for conflict is in the dojo."
- "Adis Truth-Bloom, have you adapted to the Tenno Ways?"
"When the applications of Tauron are applied to Naramon's theories, what is the expected outcome?"
A new Somatic connection. (or) A regression in stability.
- "No cheating! If you are tested by the Seven, we must show your evolution to their ways."
- "No cheating! Especially when the answer is grievously incorrect! Would you embarrass us so before the Seven?"
- "The treaty is not as finished as we would wish. The conditions laid upen our stewardship -"
- "And so you returned without Adis? Most unfortunate. Your, ah, patron has asked me to inquire about... the voices?"
"Let us hope so. Now. What would you say is Galastra's goal?"
She's trying to restart the war by turning Sentients hostile.
- "A sound hypothesis. We know she can undo the liberating effect of the blooms."
She wants Tau for herself and her followers.
- "To be promised land as a reward for fighting, only to see it given to the enemy... It must be bitter indeed."
- "Ah, the lament of the true Archimedean. 'Insufficient data'."
- "Your somatic readout indicates emotional stress. I am not judging you for what happened, Tenno. But we must find Adis."
- "With the Seven split, Ballas held the casting vote. Peace is entirely in his hands, and the warmongers whisper in his ear day and night. Your presence may offend him."
- "Orokin gratitude is like summer lightning: its light is fleeting merely, and wrath soon follows. Wait outside. I shall do what I can."

- "It's Galastra, Executor. Her Anarchs now occupy every one of the known world-seeders. Many of our bloom nurseries lie in ashes! Tokh-Amn itself is threatened! We believe she may be receiving assistance. Executor Nitokh is helping.
- "I have spoken to my fellow Archimedean. Your... consort? It appears the world-seeders have a weakness."

- "When I told Executor Ballas of the peril Tokh-Amn was facing, I little thought he would place me in charge of its defense. In this sacred place, the minds that had begun to grow on our long journey finally flowered. Tenno, Adis, in the spirit of Tokh-Amn I bind your souls together. Be the example we look to, the living truth of peace. The two of you have already been tested deeply, beyond any grade or metric. I have nothing left to teach. I deem you both Tauron Adept. May your union never be sundered."
- "A graduation present from the lady herself."
- "Thank you, Tenno. You two have been a singular headache at times, but I admit I shall miss our classes. Perhaps you might consider returning next year, to speak to the new students."
- "Tested in truth. You pass. I deem you both Tauron Adept. May your union never be sundered."
